additional_info.subject: Re: ID0409380-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP/ P8 170001007] Not exceed 150kW of power CRM:00921001581
additional_info.body:
Hello
Florent Nicolas
,
Hope you are doing well.
We apologize for the delayed reply. The voltage reflected in the logs represents the maximum battery voltage of the EV. As the state of charge (SOC) of the EV increases, the charger gradually increases the voltage to match the battery's requirements.
2025-02-26T09:16:01.442240+00:00 swcpu [user:debug] [4021] [DCC] |2025-02-26T09:13:18|DC1: |EVSE_MaxPwr[kW]=172|EVSE_MaxCur[A]=400|EVSE_NowPwr[kW]=148.6|EVSE_NowCur[A]=393|
EVSE_NowVol[V]=377.6|
EV_TarCur[A]=395|
EV_TarVol[V]=430|
EV_SOC[%]=24|EVSE_DESpwr[kW]=172|Pilot=4
Additionally, I will explain this using the examples you provided in previous mail:
|
EVSE_MaxPwr[kW]=
172
|EVSE_MaxCur[A]=400|EVSE_NowPwr[kW]=
150.2
|EVSE_NowCur[A]=398|
EVSE_NowVol[V]=377.3
|EV_TarCur[A]=399|
E
V_TarVol[V]=430
|EV_SOC[%]=21|EVSE_DESpwr[kW]=172|Pilot=4
1.The V-request represents a voltage target that can't be overshot. The EVSE_NowVol represents the output voltage of the converters, which corresponds to the battery voltage, excluding a small voltage drop due to the CCS cable resistance multiplied by the output current. Here, EV_TarVol[V] = 430 is the maximum voltage of the EV. The EVSE_NowVol[V] could be somewhere between the EV_TarVol[V] and the Battery Voltage.  If no issues occur during the entire charging session, then there is no problem. The EV requests, and the EVSE provides. Additionally, it depends on the nature of the EV to reduce charging power as the state of charge (SOC) increases.
2. As you can see in this log, what matters here is that the
EV_TarCur[A]
matches the
EVSE_NowCur[A]
as much as possible.
So, what is happening here?
The EV (vehicle) is requesting the charger to provide 399 amperes, in accordance with ISO and DIN standards. The EVSE (charger) will attempt to supply as much current as possible.
If you need further clarification on anything, please feel free to ask.
Regards,
Beerpal Singh
eMobility Support
